title: Data Provenance Aggregation and Structural Descriptors for Query-Template Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.22705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Runtime query similarity identification supports several activities, including workload analysis, identifying recurring behaviour, auditing, debugging, and anomaly detection. Existing methods for evaluating query similarity mostly rely on SQL text, execution plans, or result values but do not account for input data or how results are derived during query execution.   This paper proposes a novel approach using data provenance for query-template identification. We construct query-level profiles that capture explicit data dependencies, occurrence frequencies, and structural properties by aggregating tuple-level Lineage and Why-provenance across entire query results. We also derive Provenance Structural Descriptors (PSD), which summarise these profiles using a small set of numerical features.   We evaluate our proposals using these profiles to identify query templates over \(12{,}500\) distinct query instances generated from parametrised T

translated_title: 面向查询模板识别的数据溯源聚合与结构描述符
translated_abstract: 运行时查询相似性识别支持多项活动，包括工作负载分析、识别重复行为、审计、调试和异常检测。现有的查询相似性评估方法主要依赖SQL文本、执行计划或结果值，但并未考虑输入数据或查询执行期间结果的推导过程。本文提出了一种利用数据溯源进行查询模板识别的新方法。我们通过在整个查询结果上聚合元组级的Lineage和Why-provenance，构建捕获显式数据依赖、出现频率和结构属性的查询级画像。我们还推导出了溯源结构描述符，即使用一小组数值特征来概括这些画像。我们使用这些画像在由参数化T生成的12,500个不同查询实例上进行查询模板识别，从而评估我们提出的方案。
tldr: 本文提出通过聚合元组级Lineage与Why-provenance构建查询级画像并推导溯源结构描述符（PSD），利用数据依赖与结构属性实现查询模板识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel query-template identification approach that aggregates tuple-level Lineage and Why-provenance into query-level profiles and derives Provenance Structural Descriptors (PSD) to capture data dependencies and structural properties.
